scope: Board exam setup preview and existing learner mobile/accessibility contracts
changes: Full-board distribution preview is limited to the selected board and hidden in focused-subject mode.
A live status message explains that a focused-subject simulation does not represent the full-board distribution.
Changing boards clears a selected subject that is no longer eligible before calculating the displayed preview.
Official group and mapped subarea counts update after the question-count control changes.
Distribution areas use one column under the existing narrow-screen media rule; long area labels wrap.
Without JavaScript, the server-rendered selected-board state remains available and the page no longer forces all ten board previews open. Timer fallback behavior is preserved.

responsive_verification.tested_css_contract: Single-column distribution list at the existing narrow-screen breakpoint; wrap-safe labels; existing 44px touch-target/accessibility contracts.
responsive_verification.real_browser: NOT_EXECUTED; Chromium/Playwright visual acceptance unavailable on this Termux runtime

known_limitations: No rendered screenshots, actual viewport overflow measurements, or screen-reader session were produced.
The contract confirms responsive rules and control state transitions, not rendered visual acceptance.
